page: Microsoft Azure E2ds_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine hosted on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is driven by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8272CL processor running at a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz. Hardware resources include 2 dedicated vCPUs provisioned across 1 physical core with 2 threads per core. Cache configuration comprises 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 35 MB shared L3 cache, supported by instruction set extensions including AVX-512 and AES. Memory allocation is set at 16.0 GB, yielding a high 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. Ephemeral local storage is provided via an integrated 81 GB SSD. The configuration includes no discrete graphics processing units and allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark measurements indicate consistent single-threaded execution balanced against throughput ceilings typical of lower core counts. Single-thread evaluations yielded a Geekbench score of 1,188.0 and a bzip3 decompression rate of 9.08 GB/sec, placing in the average tier. Conversely, multi-threaded metrics reflect the dual-thread ceiling, with Geekbench multi-core reaching 1,400.0 and PassMark CPU scoring 2,218.04, both placing in the bottom 10 percent. Measured memory bandwidth registered 11.88 GB/sec for large read blocks and 8.93 GB/sec for write blocks. Application testing demonstrated 1.76 million operations per second on Redis SET tasks and 1.97 GB/sec static web serving throughput.

The E2ds_v4 provides cost-efficient memory density for infrastructure designs that require substantial RAM without paying for unused processing cores. The primary architectural tradeoff is limited CPU parallelism and low aggregate memory bandwidth, which restricts high-volume transactional pipelines and intensive compilation workloads. The integrated 81 GB SSD offers low-latency local scratch space for temporary data handling. The server fits workloads such as small relational databases, distributed caching nodes, staging infrastructure, basic data transformation tasks, and memory-dependent microservices.
description: Microsoft Azure E2ds_v4 is an entry-level memory-optimized instance engineered for workloads demanding an elevated memory-to-vCPU ratio. Built on Microsoft Hyper-V, it features a 2.6 GHz Intel Xeon 8272CL processor with 2 dedicated vCPUs derived from a single physical core, 16.0 GB of RAM, and 81 GB of local SSD storage. The hardware includes AVX-512 extensions and 35 MB of L3 cache, with no discrete GPU hardware attached. In benchmark tests, the instance shows modest single-core responsiveness with a Geekbench single-core score of 1,188.0, though multi-threaded capacity and memory bandwidth remain constrained within lower performance brackets. The resource profile makes the E2ds_v4 a practical choice for cost-conscious deployments requiring moderate RAM without excess processing overhead. It is well suited for running lightweight database nodes, local Redis or Memcached instances, staging environments, and basic caching or data processing microservices.
